en.grading.title: How we grade
en.grading.intro: Each check looks at the area within {radius} m of the place you tap and gives it a grade from A to D.
en.grading.rule.no_data: When a source has nothing for this area, the grade is “no data”. We never fill in a missing value.
en.grading.rule.trend: Heat, greenery and flood use 25 years of data. A trend counts as significant when its p-value is below 0.05.
en.grading.rule.resolution: Resolution is the size of one cell in the source data: 30 m, 1 km or 10 km. Coarser data says less about this exact area.
en.grading.rule.nasa: Most checks use NASA data. Checks marked “non-NASA data” use other open datasets.
en.grading.rule.signals: Grades are risk signals, not an official assessment.
